messages:
olivia: Noticed a spike of DAST findings from the staging suite after yesterday's role-change rollout. Many are low-confidence auth-related issues that only show up when the scanner can't assume the staging-test role.

raj: Which role change? The infra team tightened sts:AssumeRole for cross-account testing, right?

olivia: Yes, PR #5198 restricted assume role to service accounts. Staging test-runner still uses an older machine user. Example failure from the scanner: 
```text
2026-07-02T09:12:04Z WARN dast: unauthenticated-redirect detected but unable to confirm session cookie due to assume-role failure
Error: AccessDenied: sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-test-role

AuditID=AZ12-9987
```

sam: That will cause both false positives and some real misses. If the scanner is unauthenticated it flags open redirects and auth bypass heuristics more aggressively.

jules: Can we make the DAST runner gracefully downgrade to an "unauthenticated scan" mode and mark findings as low-confidence instead of gating merges? We had a lot of flakes yesterday.

sec-bot: Audit log shows 37 sts:AssumeRole DENY events from scanner-ci at 09:11 UTC. Ticket created: SEC-DAST-890.

olivia: For immediate triage I propose: 1) add temporary scan suppression metadata for the affected pipeline, 2) create a scoped IAM principal for the scanner with exact AssumeRole permission, 3) update security-review checklist to require confirmation of scanner identity changes when RBAC PRs touch cross-account policies.

raj: I'm fine with a scoped principal. Long-term we should prefer short-lived session creds via OIDC rather than long-lived machine users. I'll add that to infra backlog.

sam: Technical mitigation commands I'm going to run (will coordinate with infra):
```bash
# create a scanner role in testing account and allow OIDC trust from CI
aws iam create-role --role-name ci-dast-scanner --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name ci-dast-scanner --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
```
Note: will scope policies further.

jules: While infra acts, QA can mark the pipeline findings as non-blocking. I'll add a suppression file at `.dast/suppressions/staging-temporary.yaml` that includes: `reason: sts-assume-failure`, `expire: 2026-07-03T12:00:00Z`, `ticket: SEC-DAST-890`.

olivia: Please make the suppression machine-verifiable (expire timestamp) so it won't be forgotten. We should also require a follow-up PR to revert it.

sec-bot: Adding label `investigation=dast-assume-role` and auto-reminder for 24h.

raj: Proposal for review process change: when PRs modify cross-account trust or KMS key policies, add a checkbox in the security review form: "Impact on CI scanners / test principals" with required ack from owning infra team.

sam: Good idea. Also update the scanning pipeline to emit a specific exit code when it detects assume-role failures so automation can apply suppressions automatically instead of humans doing it.

olivia: Action list for this thread:
- sam: create scoped scanner principal + OIDC trust and post the ARN (SEC-DAST-890).
- jules: add suppression file that auto-expires (dast suppression PR).
- raj: update infra backlog for OIDC migration and add PR guard checklist change.
- sec-bot: keep audit trail and close when replayed builds pass.

qa-bot: Re-run of staging suite after role grant shows DAST finding count down from 58 -> 6. 6 are medium-confidence auth issues, opening SEC-TICKET-891 for triage.

sam: Confirmed grant applied. I posted the new role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-dast-scanner. OIDC work is tracked in INFRA-2520.

jules: Suppression merged and labeled with the ticket. It will expire at 2026-07-03T12:00:00Z. PR to remove suppression: SRE-PR-701.

olivia: Good. Long-term notes: we should add a section to the Secure SDLC playbook describing common side effects of RBAC changes (SAST/DAST scanner identity, KMS decrypt paths, artifact signing) and standard mitigations (ephemeral grants, machine-verifiable suppressions, replay builds). I'll draft and link to SEC-RFC-2026-07.

sec-bot: SEC-DAST-890 closed. Follow-ups: INFRA-2520, SEC-RFC-2026-07, SRE-PR-701.

olivia: Thanks team. If anyone touches cross-account or key policies next week, ping me in #eng-security before merging.

sam: Will do.
